title: NFCPS One 1.8.12 Offline Intro
notes: The cinematic NFCPS One intro now plays on every app launch and is packaged inside the Android app for instant offline playback. The WebView loads behind the intro, so slow network no longer exposes a white loading screen. Remember me remains independent: signed-in members go from intro straight to Home, while signed-out members see Sign in/Create account after the intro.
